crossRefs.note: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.
Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.”
So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.

translations.web: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city, and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.
translations.bsb: While the women were on their way, some of the guards went into the city and reported to the chief priests all that had happened.
translations.kjv: Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done.
translations.asv: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guard came into the city, and told unto the chief priests all the things that were come to pass.
